chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Ubayd, from Yunus, from Is'haq ibn 'Ammar, from Abu Baseer, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'The adulterer, when he commits adultery, is whipped three times, and is killed in the fourth, meaning when he has been whipped three times.'
ai.seo_question: What is the punishment for an adulterer who commits adultery multiple times according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi clarifies the jurisprudential distinction between *Hadd* (fixed punishment) and *Qatl* (execution) for the adulterer (*Zani*), establishing that the third whipping serves as the final corporal punishment, with execution reserved for the fourth recurrence. While the chapter title in some editions refers to the third instance, the text explicitly links the death penalty to the fourth occurrence, reflecting the Shia scholarly view on the cumulative nature of major sins (*Fawakih*) and the transition from corrective discipline to capital punishment for persistent offenders.
